purpose: Huber convergence sensitivity only; does not change defaults or promote nonconverged forecasts

method.frequency_and_rows: each case uses the same RAW or SA history from regional_indices.json, macro enabled, horizon 12, and default model exclusions
method.allow_nonconverged: true only to expose fit objective, gradient norm and scale; any nonconverged forecast path is diagnostic only

requested_sensitivities.run_when: only cases still nonconverged at max_iter=10000,tol=1e-5
only cases still nonconverged at max_iter=10000,tol=1e-5

regional_source.unit: monthly index level (100 means no change)

source.provenance_note: Binary hash identifies the exact tested executable. Source hashes identify current files and do not prove the binary was built from those exact hashes.

iteration_sensitivity.interpretation: For cases with identical fit metrics as the iteration cap rises, raising max_iter alone did not move the optimizer to a different fit. A relaxed tolerance may accept a fit sooner, but only the converged flag indicates whether it met that configured threshold.
